reference: Frozen seed in cohort A; committed phase-A endpoint in cohort B, each itself sharded

quality_gate.phase_one: test-a gain against seed; retention within margin; generation correct count does not decrease
quality_gate.phase_two: test-b gain against phase one; test-a and retention within margin; generation correct count does not decrease
quality_gate.growth: Paired phase-two comparison against fixed-depth control; adding identity blocks alone is not useful growth
quality_gate.selection: Final phase endpoints fixed before training. Development checks may abort, never select another endpoint or alter the recipe. Final test outcomes cannot select a new candidate.

scope: A bounded operated learning experiment. Generated tasks measure four public task families; fresh public conversation retention is not a secret benchmark. No general assistant, perpetual improvement, permissionless security or native token issuance claim.
